name: Contract & Foundation Documents
description: Core legal agreements, annexures, and work orders that establish the project's scope, terms, and conditions.

children.name: Core Agreements
children.description: The primary contract, schedules of quantities, and annexures detailing project terms, milestones, and conditions.

children.name: Work Orders & Amendments
children.description: Initial work orders authorizing the project and supplementary orders that modify scope, rates, or quantities for extra items or deviations.

name: Project Management Correspondence
description: Day-to-day communications regarding project execution, progress, and on-site issues.

children.name: Progress & Performance
children.description: Letters and notices concerning project timelines, delays, slow progress, and performance evaluations.

children.name: Site Issues & Hindrances
children.description: Communications detailing on-site hindrances (e.g., soil conditions, waterlogging), quality control issues, and technical challenges.

children.name: Requests & Authorizations
children.description: Formal requests for extensions of time, permission to resume work, and other project-related authorizations.

name: Financial Administration & Claims
description: Documents related to billing, payment, cost claims, and financial securities for the project.

children.name: Billing & Invoicing
children.description: Submission of interim (RA), final, and escalation bills for work completed, including transmittal letters.

children.name: Cost Claims & Charges
children.description: Documents detailing claims for additional costs due to delays (prolongation), unforeseen circumstances (e.g., COVID-19), or other factors.

children.name: Payment Records & Requests
children.description: Vouchers, memoranda of payment, and letters formally requesting the release of funds.

children.name: Financial Guarantees
children.description: Documents related to performance bonds, security deposits, and other bank guarantees.

name: Dispute & Legal
description: Formal communications that escalate disagreements into official disputes, including legal notices and formal demands.

children.name: Formal Notices
children.description: Official demand notices for payment or action, and the formal replies to such notices, often preceding legal action.

children.name: Contested Actions
children.description: Correspondence formally disputing actions taken by a party, such as the levying of penalties or compensation.

name: Project Closure
description: Official documents signifying the completion of work and the final settlement of the project.

children.name: Completion Certificates
children.description: Formal certificates confirming the satisfactory completion of the project work as per the contract.
